newsitem.title: USA: Stone Energy Louisiana well flows 845 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Stone Energy Louisiana well flows 845 bpd.

text.p: Stone Energy Corp said Thursday limited tests of the Goodrich-Cocke No. 3 Well flowed 845 barrels of oil and 500,000 cubic feet of natural gas per day, and the well is expected to begin production late this month.

The company said directionally drilled well reached a depth of 9,786 feet and logged 142 net feet of oil productive interval. Perforations between 9,540 feet and 9,560 feet with a flowing tubing pressure of 790 pounds per square inch on a 20/64-inch choke were tested.
The well is located in the company's West Weeks Island Field onshore in Iberia Parish, La., and the company owns a 100 percent working interest before payout in the well, it said.
Stone Energy plans to drill two development wells and recomplete two other wells in the field during the first half of 1997.

A spokesman said the company is going to initially record a revenue interest of 65 percent after payout, but expects once unitization is completed Stone's interest will exceed 70 percent. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
